strings.zh: 好不容易来红莲岛旅次游,{NEWLINE}要给家人带点什么特产回去好呢？
strings.en: I finally made it to Cinnabar Island on{NEWLINE}vacation. What local specialty should I{CLEAR}bring home for my family?
strings.notes: Cinnabar Island tourists and a shop; the hack reuses the vanilla Global Terminal 3F bank (#3-#8 are vanilla Battle Video lines).

strings.zh: 每年我都会来红莲岛度假一次,{NEWLINE}这里热腾腾的熔岩总会给我一种{CLEAR}充满活力的感觉。
strings.en: I come to Cinnabar Island on vacation{NEWLINE}once every year.{SCROLL}The piping-hot lava here always makes{NEWLINE}me feel full of energy.

strings.zh: 本来还想在旅游胜地的道馆{NEWLINE}打卡拍照的,{CLEAR}结果人家说红莲道馆不开了,{CLEAR}真是太可惜了。
strings.en: I wanted to snap a photo at the Gym in{NEWLINE}this tourist hot spot, but they told me{CLEAR}the Cinnabar Gym is closed.{SCROLL}What a shame.

strings.zh: 我呢,光注意　{NEWLINE}可爱的玛力露{CLEAR}战斗的视频了。
strings.en: My Battle Videos starring only cute{NEWLINE}little Marill are the ones I like best.

strings.zh: 全是精彩的战斗录像啊！{NEWLINE}明白为什么这么有人气了！{SCROLL}因为,感觉好像看看{NEWLINE}就可能变强了呢！
strings.en: They’re all amazing battles! I can see{NEWLINE}why they’re so popular!{SCROLL}It feels like just watching them might{NEWLINE}make you stronger!

strings.zh: 这样每天都享受着战斗录像。{SCROLL}这就是所谓绅士的嗜好吧。
strings.en: To treat one’s self to Battle Videos{NEWLINE}every day...{SCROLL}I would consider that a hobby worthy{NEWLINE}of a true gentleman.

strings.zh: 神奇的战斗录像,{NEWLINE}神奇的战斗录像,{SCROLL}放这个了哦,{NEWLINE}放这个了哦,{SCROLL}怎样呢？{NEWLINE}怎样呢怎样呢！
strings.en: My mysterious Battle Video.{NEWLINE}My mysterious Battle Video.{SCROLL}What’s on it?{NEWLINE}What’s on it?{SCROLL}It’s a mystery!{NEWLINE}It’s a mystery! And I mean it!

strings.zh: 满金市的取字{NEWLINE}造句游戏开始啦！{SCROLL}满……满金市往南是{NEWLINE}桐树林{SCROLL}金……锦绣繁华的{NEWLINE}满金市的地下通道{SCROLL}市……是穿黑衣的{NEWLINE}火箭队在我睡觉时{CLEAR}偷走了我的东西！
strings.en: Let me attempt the alphabet rap using{NEWLINE}Goldenrod, dig?{SCROLL}G... Go south from here for the{NEWLINE}Ilex Forest.{SCROLL}O... Over land is not where you’ll find{NEWLINE}the Goldenrod Tunnel.{SCROLL}L... Looking like criminals in their black{NEWLINE}pajamas is Team Rocket.{SCROLL}D... Um... D... is...{NEWLINE}Yeah, I know, lame-o.{CLEAR}You give it a try!
strings.notes: US 0602/7; US line kept: vanilla Goldenrod acrostic (满金市) left unchanged by the hack; the US localisation adapts the wordplay.

strings.zh: 我是个登山爱好者,{NEWLINE}我喜欢玩{CLEAR}二楼的盒子速照！
strings.en: I’m a big hiking fan, and I love the Box{NEWLINE}snapshots on the second floor!
strings.notes: 盒子速照 read as the vanilla Box snapshot feature on 2F; vanilla leftover.
Shop list: zh has item + price on one line, kept on one line (${price} before the amount, D-0008). TM35 = Flamethrower (HGSS). Check the list width in game.

strings.en: Here you go. Thank you for your{NEWLINE}business.

strings.zh: 对不起顾客,{NEWLINE}您身上的钱好像不够啊。
strings.en: Sorry, it looks like you don’t have{NEWLINE}enough money.
